questions.title: Does any open ticket unlock full bank details, or only a payout ticket?
questions.question: A support agent has an open ticket for this merchant, but it is about a refund, not a payout. Should the agent see the full account number, routing number and account holder name, or only the last four digits of the account?

options.label: Only a payout ticket: a refund ticket shows just the last four digits
options.clarification: A support agent sees full bank details only when they have an open ticket for that merchant whose topic is a payout problem; with any other ticket topic they see only the last four digits of the account number.

options.label: Any open ticket for that merchant shows full details
options.clarification: A support agent with an open ticket of any topic for that merchant sees the full account number, routing number and account holder name.
